title: Research with a clear reading order
items: Research now opens with one large featured read, then an Upset radar beside a narrow rail with the stat of the week, notable teams and @timurknowsball's record.
The two upset cards are merged into one Upset radar, and the three conference cards into one Conference landscape with Strength, Parity and Teams tabs.
Rating vs schedule is full width and labels only the top three teams; hover any dot for the rest. Toughest schedules shows five teams, with the full list behind View all.

News cards show the category and original publication on top, the aggregator in the footer, and two-line excerpts. The top two stories are wider, and the filter bar switches between sources and categories.
Page titles now carry a short descriptor on the right instead of an explanatory sentence underneath.
